points.text: A fire at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta killed four people and injured dozens.
A large Ukrainian drone attack targeted St. Petersburg, damaging infrastructure including an oil facility; Russian authorities reported casualties and intercepted drones.
A truck drove into a youth soccer game in Wichita, killing a six-year-old boy and a 35-year-old man and sending at least 10 others to hospital.
Protests in France over living costs and school conditions turned violent, with demonstrators targeting buildings and shops and clashing with police.
Super Typhoon Champi is expected to enter the Philippine Area of Responsibility on October 20, bringing forecast strong winds and heavy rain.
